# n-epi

A static, client-side reference tool for epidemiology, biostatistics, and
clinical research methods. No accounts, no server, no tracking; runs fully in
the browser. Results render as on-page HTML tables and text alongside canvas
charts. Single-page app with hash routing (append #module-id to the site URL).

## Data boundary

Public, synthetic, aggregate, or de-identified examples only. Do not enter PHI,
patient identifiers, limited datasets, restricted research data, learner
records, credentials, or confidential institutional data. Not a substitute for a
biostatistician's review, and not for clinical decision-making or patient care.

## Study Design
- Sample Size (#sample-size): sample-size calculators for 8 designs.
- Power Analysis (#power-analysis): power from N, curves, comparisons.
- Hypothesis Builder (#hypothesis-builder): PICO/PECO, analysis plans.
- Design Guide (#study-design-guide): study-design selection and references.

## Epidemiology
- Epi Calculators (#epidemiology-calcs): 2x2, stratified analysis, rates, SMR.
- Epi Concepts (#epi-concepts): frequency, association, impact, validity.
- Causal Inference (#causal-inference): Bradford Hill, DAGs, counterfactuals.

## Biostatistics
- Effect Sizes (#effect-size): OR/RR/RD/d/g conversions.
- NNT / NNH (#nnt-calculator): NNT/NNH from rates, 2x2, or OR/RR.
- Diagnostic Accuracy (#diagnostic-accuracy): 2x2, Wilson CIs, Fagan, ROC.
- Regression Planning (#regression-helper): model selection, EPV, DAGs.
- Survival Analysis (#survival-analysis): Kaplan-Meier, log-rank, HR.
- Biostats Reference (#biostats-reference): test selector, distributions, CIs.
- Results Interpreter (#results-interpreter): plain-language interpretation.

## Clinical Trials
- Trial Database (#trial-database): reference set of clinical trials.
- Critical Appraisal (#critical-appraisal): RoB 2, NOS, AMSTAR-2, QUADAS-2, GRADE.
- Reporting Guidelines (#reporting-guidelines): CONSORT, STROBE, PRISMA.

## Meta-Analysis
- Meta-Analysis (#meta-analysis): fixed/random effects, forest and funnel plots.

## ML & Prediction
- ML for Research (#ml-prediction): method selection, validation, TRIPOD+AI.

## Writing & Productivity
- Methods Generator (#methods-generator): statistical methods paragraphs.
- Project Planner (#project-planner): timelines, milestones, checklists.

## Tools & Reference
- R Code Library (#r-code-library): R code recipes.
- Teaching Tools (#teaching-tools): quizzes, worksheets, glossary.
- Quick Reference (#quick-reference): printable reference cards.
- Biobank Cleaning (#biobank-cleaning): standardize and check biobank data.
